meta.scope: offline static; reads receipts only, no module loaded, no radio contacted
meta.method: the same five ordered rules as Stage 893A over the module subset, plus a per-module label distribution and live fraction
premise_corrections: a module claim inherits the weakest evidence in its chain, so per-module counts must be separated before any single claim is quoted
static symbol analysis of a .ko does not become hardware evidence when the module happens to be installed on a live radio

order: R4 static scope or binary hashes

gaps: module attribution comes from string presence, so a receipt that mentions a module only as a counter-example is still attributed to it
a per-module live fraction is not a per-claim provenance: a single live receipt does not upgrade static siblings
eab_driver appears in receipts whose source binary is absent from the corpus
no module was loaded and no radio was contacted by this stage
